what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine in Egypt whom UNHCR counts, at the end of each year from 1995 to 2022.
At the end of 2022, the last year in UNHCR's series for this group, it counted 70020 refugees, 67.1% of all Palestinian refugees that UNHCR counts.
In 2025 the largest numbers of Palestinian refugees in UNHCR's data live in Greece, Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 70255, at the end of 2005, and stayed close to that level until 2022.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Egypt.
These are year-end totals for Egypt only, reported to UNHCR, and the series ends in 2022.
